facts.fact: UNESCO's account says participants at the 26 May 2026 consultation expressed concern about the absence of existing binding mechanisms to monitor AI-related harms in Uganda, particularly in gender and health.
UNESCO reports the Lead National Expert as saying Uganda lacks a comprehensive AI-specific legal framework.

UGA.note: No AI tool in a public sector system stated.

facts.fact: The document refers to Uganda's forthcoming National AI and Emerging Technologies Strategy, which the Lead National Expert said Uganda needs to finalise and adopt.
facts.system: National AI and Emerging Technologies Strategy

UGA.note: No locally built AI model, dataset or computing stated.
No government hosting or cloud policy stated.
Data centres mentioned only as lacking environmental impact assessment rules; none stated as for hire or in service.

facts.fact: The document names Uganda's Data Protection and Privacy Act (2019) as an existing instrument that does not address algorithmic transparency or automated decision-making.

UGA.note: No rural access programme or rural and urban use figures stated.
Only 'nearly four times the UN benchmark', no share or price stated.
No data centre ownership or hosting stated.
The consultation was on UNESCO's readiness assessment, not a named law or policy put to outside participants.
